controller.workflow: Model Packs / Import Local Pack, then Run Model / Start, Runtime / Stop

production_differences.work: ordinary writable container filesystem; no mount

validation.eos: Baked guard enabled; observed reasoning-close token before clean stop and final answer
validation.target_query_graphs: C1-C4 active on all ranks; changed-input gates pass; no graph failure logs
validation.disk_ple: Original read-only mmap, bounded 5 MiB pinned stage per rank, eight gather threads
validation.prior_short_check: One of eight initial concurrency responses exhausted 512 response tokens during reasoning; retained and narrowed repeat passed. No pack changes between checks.

counter_semantics.source: Baked scheduler update_draft_token_ids_in_output validates grammar and records num_invalid_spec_tokens; make_spec_decoding_stats subtracts these before SpecDecodingStats.observe_draft. Scheduler can also schedule partial rounds.
counter_semantics.evidence: counter-source-hashes.json and original counter assertion/error logs
counter_semantics.interpretation: Exact aggregate 7xrounds is not a valid invariant for mixed grammar-constrained tool traffic. Serving settings and C1-C4 full-width graph dispatch prove seven-token execution. Exact per-step source of each deducted token was not instrumented.
counter_semantics.separate_unconstrained_repeat: Earlier two-wave concurrency-only repeat: 648 rounds, 4536 proposals, exactly seven per round.

limits: Targeted local-image compatibility only; no full-context or benchmark rerun.
Diagnostic in-memory snapshots/timing/RPCs omitted; graph evidence is from baked serving logs.
Image registry publication and remote acquisition remain unverified and unpublished.
Earlier run reused an existing Controller checkpoint copy; final run verifies original qualification checkpoint inodes through the supported existing inventory.
